node.title: Re: perl XML::LibXML help reading an xml file that uses namespaces (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [HeadScratcher],

tell the difference between the 2 'title' fields

//dft:title means to find the corresponding </c> nodes anywhere in the tree. To select the <c><title></c> that is a child of <c><feed></c>, use for example <c>/dft:feed/dft:title</c>, or to select <c><title></c> nodes that are children of <c><entry></c> nodes anywhere in the tree, you could use <c>//dft:entry/dft:title</c>. There are other ways to tell nodes apart, such as using attributes, siblings, etc. - choosing the correct XPath conditions for selecting the nodes is up to you, depending on the structure of the document and your own criteria.</p> <blockquote><i>how do I get the value of point?</i></blockquote> <p><c>xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"</c> will be the namespace of nodes that don't have any prefix. So <c><point></c> is in that namespace, and in your XPath you've given that namespace the alias <c>dft</c>. The proper XPath expression is then <c>//georss:where/dft:point</c></p> <p>Note these aren't really Perl questions, really more like XPath questions, you I'd recommend you look into XPath a bit more.</p> <p>Hope this helps,<br>-- Hauke D</p> <p><i>Update:</i> s/direct descendant/child/g</p>
